entry.note: Retained exact way 128264422 / Q3679864 is current viewer building 35184500353254. Its nine current outer vertices, original anchor and heading remain unchanged. Positive X is approximately east, positive Z approximately south. Pictures from the northwest and south place the two tall minarets on the western side, the main gold dome over the central prayer block, and smaller corner turrets toward the east. Current PMTiles have no height tags or independent roof/tower parts. All internal plans, turret positions, facade divisions and vertical dimensions are picture estimates. The separate northern low building 35184418943116 remains host content; its footprint is preserved rather than absorbed into the main mosque.
